description: Get OS-level monitoring data for a Search Engine Service node

interval.description: Aggregation interval (e.g. Min1, Min30, Hour2, Day1). Default: Min1

metric.description: Metric set to retrieve. OS_ALL_METRICS is the only valid value

timeStart.description: Start time as epoch milliseconds (e.g. 1742520660000) — NOT an ISO 8601 string

name: ncloud_ses_get_os_monitoring
